title: Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD) Abuse

references.name: MITRE ATT&CK - T1558 Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets

description: Resource-based constrained delegation is controlled by the msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute on the target computer object. An attacker who holds write privileges over a computer object (for example, GenericWrite or WriteProperty) can populate this attribute with a controlled account and then impersonate any user to that computer, including local administrators. The ability to create machine accounts (default MachineAccountQuota) often provides the controlled account needed.
businessImpact: Critical --- successful abuse grants administrative access to the targeted host by impersonating privileged users, enabling lateral movement and further escalation.
remediation:
- Review and restrict write permissions (ACLs) on computer objects; remove unnecessary GenericWrite/GenericAll grants.
- Set the ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0 so standard users cannot create computer accounts.
- Add privileged accounts to the Protected Users group and mark them as non-delegatable.
- Audit the msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute for unexpected values.
